Details

Powered by a Tranexin Nia C Liposome 25% formula, this brightening serum is designed to visibly improve dark spots, uneven tone, and dullness. A concentrated blend of tranexamic acid, niacinamide, and vitamin C derivatives works deep within the skin to target pigmentation and discoloration, while Yuzu and Lime extracts gently refine texture for a smoother, more radiant finish.

Its lightweight, moisture-rich base absorbs quickly without stickiness—making it a seamless addition to any routine.

30ml / 1.01 FL. OZ.

Ingredients

Ingredients We Love

Tranexamic Acid, Niacinamide, Vitamin C Derivative(AscorbylTetraisopalmitate), Glycolic Acid and Citric Acid -Yuzu & Lime Extract

Full List of Ingredients

Water, Diphenylsiloxy Phenyl Trimethicone, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Isononyl Isononanoate, Propanediol, Niacinamide(20,100ppm), 1,2-Hexanediol, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Castor Oil/IPDI Copolymer, C12-14 Alketh-12, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Tromethamine, Xanthan Gum, Fragrance, Ethylhexylglycerin, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Limonene, Arginine, Carbomer, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Amodimethicone, Allantoin, Benzyl Benzoate, Polyglyceryl-10 Laurate, Linalool, Hexyl Cinnamal, Limnanthes Alba (Meadowfoam) Seed Oil, Coptis Japonica Root Extract, Citric Acid, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Glycolic Acid, Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate(2ppm), Panthenol(2ppm), Caprylyl Glycol, Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate(1ppm), Sodium Hyaluronate, Citrus Aurantifolia (Lime) Fruit Extract, Centella Asiatica Extract, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract, Citrus Junos Fruit Extract, Glutathione, Arbutin, Tranexamic Acid, Glucose, Phytosteryl/Octyldodecyl Lauroyl Glutamate, Hydroxydecyl Ubiquinone, Inulin Lauryl Carbamate, Ceramide NP, Chondrus Crispus Extract, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Hyaluronic Acid, Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate, Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate, Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer, Potassium Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Ascorbic Acid(22ppb), Biotin(22ppb), Pyridoxine(22ppb), Folic Acid(22ppb), Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Leaf Extract, Cyanocobalamin(2ppb), Tocopherol(2ppb), Riboflavin(2ppb), Thiamine HCl(2ppb), Linoleic Acid(2ppb), Beta-Carotene(2ppb)
